messages:
incident-bot: PAGE: runtime.crash.high_rate on cluster-gamma -> multiple containers in CrashLoopBackOff (segfault). Pager: @Samir (oncall). Priority: P1. Links: https://incidents.redwood/2123456789

Samir (oncall): ack. I'm on it. grabbing logs, can someone post the pod list from cluster-gamma?

Alex (runtime): logs attached from pod runtime-vllm-0 (node-17-gpu-3):
```
[2026-03-15T02:10:41Z] runtime: model loader initialized
[2026-03-15T02:10:43Z] ERROR: Unhandled signal SIGSEGV (11) at 0x7f3a2c1b9f
[2026-03-15T02:10:43Z] Backtrace: /opt/runtime/lib/custom_kernel.so(+0x1a3f) [0x7f3a2c1b9f]
[2026-03-15T02:10:43Z] CUDA: cuCtxSynchronize() failed: unspecified launch failure
[2026-03-15T02:10:43Z] runtime: aborting due to segfault
```

Mira (eng-sre): thanks. I see 6 pods in CrashLoopBackOff across node-17-gpu-3 and node-18-gpu-1. Crash window started ~02:09 UTC. Crash pattern: SIGSEGV inside custom fused kernel (custom_kernel.so) after recent rollout of fused-kernel v2.3.

Jess (support): we've got 22 customer error reports in the last 6 minutes, mostly 503/500s from generation endpoints. Support triage: impact is "degraded inference for hosted customers on west region", estimated % of requests failing ~4-6% cluster-wide, spike on models using vLLM + TRT pipeline.

Samir (oncall): immediate mitigations: (1) take affected node(s) OOS, (2) scale up CPU fallback pool, (3) patch runtime to disable fused kernels and roll. Who can run the node cordon/drain?

Mira (eng-sre): I'll cordon/drain node-17-gpu-3 now and move pods.
```
# cordon & drain
kubectl cordon node-17-gpu-3
kubectl drain node-17-gpu-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```

ops-bot: node node-17-gpu-3 cordoned by Mira at 02:13:08 UTC. Eviction started: 6 pods.

Alex (runtime): we have a quick runtime toggle to disable fused-kernel paths: set ENV REDWOOD_RUNTIME_DISABLE_FUSED=1 and restart runtime. That should avoid custom_kernel.so and fallback to standard kernels (slower but stable). I can push a hotpatched config to the daemonset if approved.

Samir (oncall): do it. Prioritize stability. Jess, inform affected customers we are mitigating and will follow up. Kelsey, are there customer SLAs in danger?

Kelsey (product): support informed, SLAs intact for most customers but we should notify a few enterprise users on Dedicated capacity if they hit latency SLOs. We're drafting a note.

Alex (runtime): applying config patch to runtime-daemonset in cluster-gamma:
```
kubectl set env ds/runtime REDWOOD_RUNTIME_DISABLE_FUSED=1 -n redwood-runtime
kubectl rollout restart ds/runtime -n redwood-runtime
```

incident-bot: Deploy started for ds/runtime. Rollout status available at https://k8s.redwood/rollouts/alpha

Mira (eng-sre): after cordon/drain, node-17 had 4 pods recreate on node-18 which then started showing OOM / cuda errors. I'm draining node-18 next to isolate.

Samir (oncall): before we drain node-18, scale up CPU fallback pool to absorb traffic:
```
rcli pools scale --pool cpu-fallback --replicas 8 --region west
```

ops-bot: cpu-fallback pool scaled to 8 replicas.

Alex (runtime): rollout status: 3/5 daemonset pods updated, others restarting. Logs show next attempts now hitting generic kernel path, no immediate segfaults on restarted pods. Error rate dropping.

Jess (support): seeing error rate reduce from ~5.2% -> 0.8% over last 4 minutes. Customers re-try rate high, support routing requests to fallback engine.

Samir (oncall): good. I'm going to move to postmortem once stabilized. Mira, you want to take a full handoff and lead the rest of the live mitigation? I'm going to hand to you in 10m.

Mira (eng-sre): taking handoff. I'll keep the node cordoned until we confirm kernel patch. Plan: (A) keep REDWOOD_RUNTIME_DISABLE_FUSED=1 for 2h, (B) roll out a build with added bounds-checks in custom_kernel and run canary on 2 nodes, (C) collect core dumps + upload to artifact store for debug. Alex, can you collect core and GPU crash dumps?

Alex (runtime): on it. Commands I'm running:
```
# enable coredump collection
kubectl exec -n redwood-runtime runtime-vllm-0 -- bash -lc "ulimit -c unlimited && echo '/tmp/core.%e.%p' > /proc/sys/kernel/core_pattern"
# collect nvidia-smi and dmesg
kubectl logs runtime-vllm-0 -n redwood-runtime --previous | tail -n 200
kubectl exec -n redwood-runtime runtime-vllm-0 -- nvidia-smi -q
kubectl exec -n redwood-runtime runtime-vllm-0 -- dmesg | tail -n 200
```

ops-bot: core dump capture enabled on runtime pods (best-effort). Uploading artifact pack to https://artifacts.redwood/corepacks/2123456789.tar.gz

Kelsey (product): customer note: "We've mitigated an intermittent crash affecting generation in US-west. Temporary fallback engaged; performance may be degraded for some models. Engineers are investigating root cause and will follow up." Approving send.

Jess (support): sent customer notifications at 02:28 UTC.

Mira (eng-sre): quick status update: all GPU nodes cordoned: node-17, node-18. Runtime daemonset rolled with REDWOOD_RUNTIME_DISABLE_FUSED=1, 9/10 pods updated, error rate at 0.4%. CPU fallback handling traffic. We're stable for now.

Samir (oncall): handing primary incident ownership to Mira for postmortem and longer-term fix. I'll remain available for escalation. Leaving the channel. :wave:

Mira (eng-sre): acknowledged handoff. Next steps for post-incident: (1) repro on internal bench with fused-kernel v2.3 and inputs that hit KV cache hotpath, (2) build hotfix with extra bounds-checks, (3) plan safe rollout with canary and automatic rollback, (4) update runtime CI to include fused-kernel stress test. Assigning Alex and Eng-ML to investigate.

Alex (runtime): noted. I'll start a debug branch and run fuzzing harness over the fused kernel with 10k random sequences. ETA initial finding 6-8 hours.

Mira (eng-sre): closing live mitigation. Maintaining follow-up ticket INC-2123456789 in backlog. If anyone sees a regression, ping me directly.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2123456789: status -> mitigated (live) by Mira at 02:36 UTC.

Jess (support): final customer update queued for 03:00 UTC with summary and next steps.

Kelsey (product): thanks team. Postmortem owner: Mira. Please include timeline, root-cause hypothesis, and remediation plan.

Mira (eng-sre): will do. Closing thread for live ops; continuing investigation in INC-2123456789 workspace.
